newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 4-Wk T-bills average yield 12.234 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech 4-Wk T-bills average yield 12.234 pct.

text.p: Average yield in an auction of four-week Czech treasury bills was 12.234 percent, and the American auction offering 3.5 billion crowns to the market was oversubscribed, the Czech National Bank said.

Maximum accepted yield was 12.27 percent while the minimum accepted yield was 12.10 percent. Bids totalled 8.285 billion crowns including 1.5 billion crowns put into the Finance Ministry's portfolio, the CNB said.
The one-month Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR) average was 12.64 percent on Thursday, one basis point under Wednesday's level.
